Subject: Vendor intake checklist delaying live demo & travel coordination

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for taking time earlier. We were planning a 60-minute live demo with the Ventum product and your execs on Oct 28 (in-person at your SF office) that would include a short Q&A and a walkthrough of latency/cost expectations. Before we lock flights and the room, procurement flagged that your vendor intake checklist needs to be completed:

- Executed NDA (legal wants a countersign)
- Vendor security questionnaire (sensitive/data handling section outstanding)
- Standard vendor intake form (procurement needs billing/tax info)

I’ve attached the vendor intake form we typically send to customers (vendor-intake.pdf). Can you confirm which items are still outstanding on your side and whether your execs are definitely available the week of Oct 26? If procurement requires completions before any exec-level demo, we should avoid booking travel until that’s sorted.

Proposed fallbacks if intake isn’t done in time:
- Short remote tech preview (30m) with engineering on Oct 28 (no execs required)
- Push the in-person demo to the first week of November (Nov 2 or Nov 9)

I’ll coordinate with Karthik and Neha on the legal/engineering side to expedite anything we can.

Thanks —
Priyom

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the heads up. Procurement and Legal are being strict this quarter — they require both a completed vendor security questionnaire and a signed NDA before we can bring execs into a live, in-person demo. Two notes from our side:

1) The procurement team just circulated the security questionnaire this morning (attached). It has a few follow-ups under "data residency" and "third-party subprocessors" that we need vendors to fill in detail on.
2) Our VP of Product is traveling the week of Oct 26 and asked that if the NDA + questionnaire aren’t complete by Friday, we move the in-person demo.

I’m attaching the questionnaire (ventum_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx). Procurement is willing to accept a signed (scanned PDF) NDA instead of waiting on DocuSign if that expedites things. I’ll try to get procurement to accept a remote tech preview if you can provide a short architecture doc and a 30-minute walkthrough for engineering next week.

Samantha

Priyom / Neha —

Legal here. Quick summary of blockers and a recommended path:

Blockers:
- NDA: our template is fine but Legal wants to review Ventum's minor redline on Section 4 (data use). That should be a 24–48 hour turnaround once Ventum sends the redline.
- Questionnaire: several items reference encryption at-rest, key lifecycle, and retention windows. Engineering needs to answer the tech sections; I can help sign off once we get the answers.
- Procurement: requires billing contact + tax ID on the intake form (Priyom, you can collect that from Alex Chen).

Recommended plan to keep momentum:
1) Offer a 30-minute remote technical preview (no execs) on Oct 28 to keep engineers engaged. Karthik/Neha can present the infrastructure and answer questionnaire items live.
2) Ask Ventum to return the questionnaire by EOD Wed (21st) and send any NDA redlines to legal@redwoodinference.com. If we get that, Legal will prioritize review and aim to have signed NDA back within 48 hours.
3) If procurement insists on execs present, we should move the in-person demo to Nov 2 or Nov 9 and lock travel after we receive the signed NDA.

DocuSign link (legal prefers signature via platform): https://www.docusign.com/secure-link/abc123-ventum-nda

I’ll draft a one-pager to accompany the technical preview so procurement has something to review quickly.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Operations (acting), Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

- I’ll collect billing contact and tax ID from Alex Chen and add it to the intake form (attached).

- Option B (exec-level demo): postpone in-person demo to Nov 2 or Nov 9 (we’re flexible — please confirm which date works for your VP). We’ll only finalize travel after we have the signed NDA.
